create_parser: create a command-line argument parser for vLLM data parallel inference with engine and DP-specific arguments
run_data_parallel_inference: run vLLM offline data parallel inference across multiple nodes with distributed prompt processing
distribute_prompts_across_ranks: distribute a list of prompts evenly across data parallel ranks for balanced workload
spawn_worker_processes: spawn multiprocessing worker processes for each data parallel rank with timeout-based kill handling
generate_text_with_sampling_params: generate text from prompts using vLLM LLM with configurable sampling parameters like temperature and top_p
